post.description: The post, page or custom post type entry whose applicable fields are wanted.

target.description: The post the fields were listed for, echoed so a response can be matched to its request.

fields.description: The top-level fields that apply to this post, in the order ACF reports them, group by group. Sub-fields are not listed: they are addressed through their parent.

key.description: ACF's field key, for example field_5f3a1b2c. The stable identifier; the name can be renamed.

name.description: The field name used in template code and as the meta key suffix.

label.description: The label shown in the editor.

type.description: The ACF field type, for example text, repeater, or flexible_content.

required.description: Whether ACF marks the field required in the editor.

groupKey.description: The key of the field group this field belongs to, as acf-group-list reports it.

groupTitle.description: That group's title, as shown in the editor.

fieldListingNotices.description: Anything the listing could not report faithfully, such as a field group whose field definitions could not be read. Names groups and counts only, never a field's value.
